description: Public discovery sources. Output is unreviewed leads, never a published event feed. Exact hosts also restrict every redirect and linked-page fetch.

sources.notes: Official DIU Student Hub public event cards. Reads one listing page; no login, registrations or pagination. Retains technology-related current/future cards and unknown-date partial leads; excludes Completed/Cancelled and past date badges. Source badge dates stay date-only, clock text has no inferred timezone, and title/date year conflicts are flagged. Individual organizers, full details and eligibility require human review.

Community aggregator. Anonymous endpoint used by the public calendar frontend, not a documented supported API. Reads one response only. Excludes Business Case and unrelated general activities; Other/Fest need title/description technology relevance. Keeps source listing and provided event links without fetching them or treating them as official. Dates/deadlines are unreviewed and retain supplied precision. Excludes past entries using end date, or start if end is absent, relative to observed Bangladesh calendar day; missing-date leads remain partial.
Official season listing; reads public embedded upcomingEvents JSON. Season URL needs annual maintenance. Organizer sites are linked but not fetched.

Official platform listing; follows only the first eight distinct jam links. Platform dates may include voting. Community listings require relevance and content review. No pagination or exhaustive coverage promised.
Official department announcements; event dates are not inferred from news publication dates. Includes partial leads and past/non-event news requiring manual triage.
